setup.title: Set up Linkrovia
setup.subtitle: Create your owner account to get started.
setup.step1: Step 1 of 3: Verify your setup token
setup.tokenHelp: Enter the value you set as SETUP_TOKEN when deploying. In the Cloudflare dashboard, open Workers & Pages, select your Linkrovia Worker, then open Settings and Variables and Secrets. If you no longer have the value, replace the secret there and deploy the change.
setup.ownerHelp: Use this email and password to sign in and manage your instance.
setup.databaseRecovery: In Cloudflare Workers & Pages, select your Linkrovia Worker. Open Bindings and select Add binding. Choose D1 database, enter DB as the variable name, select your Linkrovia database, and add the binding. Then check the configuration again.
setup.tokenMissing: Setup token is missing or invalid
setup.tokenRecovery: In Cloudflare Workers & Pages, select your Linkrovia Worker. Open Settings → Variables and Secrets. Add or update a Secret named SETUP_TOKEN using a random password of 32–512 characters. Save the value in your password manager, select Deploy, then check the configuration again. You will need the same value in the next step.
